budget_items.topic: COA Gift Fund balance and use for ADA Patio
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Director reported just under $10,000 in the COA Gift Fund and requested $5,000 of it for the ADA Patio project; the board approved by vote.
budget_items.quote: there's just under $10,000 in the fund, and requested to use $5,000 toward the ada patio project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Patio funding was listed as $100,000 from the state, $100,000 from the FY23 Capital Plan, and an $80,000 ARPA request; the board discussed cost-cutting options such as concrete instead of pavers.
budget_items.quote: there is $100,000 from the state, $100,000 from the fy23 capital plan, and ms. doherty has requested $80,000 in american rescue plan act (arpa) funds.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager reported the Capital Planning Committee is unsure of the return on investment for a $150,000 FY24 parking lot request; an alternative of extending the Kids Kingdom lot was suggested.
budget_items.quote: unsure on the return on investment for the $150,000 parking lot request for fy24.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Director will seek more hours for the Outreach Coordinator and Administrative/Transportation Coordinator and a part-time outreach assistant for ten hours per week; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: she will be seeking an increase in hours for the outreach coordinator, and administrative/transportation coordinator positions
